senses.gloss:
कौप a. (-पी f.) [कूप-अण्] Relating to or coming
 from a well (as water).

कौपीनम् [कूप-खञ्; see Sk. on शालीनकौपीने अधृष्टाकार्ययोः P. V. 2. 20]
—1 The pudenda.
—2 A privity, privy part.
—3 A small piece of cloth (usually a small strip worn over the privities;
 कौपीनं शतखण्डजर्जरतरं कन्था पुनस्तादृशी Bh. 3. 101.)
—4 (Hence sometimes) A ragged or tattered garment.
—5 Sin, an improper or wrong act; नाच्छादयति कौपीनं न दंशमशकापहम् Pt. 3. 97.
